text: A woman with long red hair, fair skin, and a slender build kneels on rubble. She wears a sheer light-blue gown tied at the waist, revealing her torso. Her face is oval, eyes amber, lips full. A dark choker and wristbands adorn her. She gazes upward, hands resting near knees. Behind her, ruined stone structures loom under a dim blue sky. No other figures are visible.
